_comment: Deferred ENFORCEMENT, with a date on it. Checked by tools/check_repo_state.py::verify_deferred_enforcement,
which runs inside the ALREADY-REQUIRED context `Repo-state - live GitHub truth verifier`, so an expiry here
turns a required check RED and blocks merges. A registry enforced by a non-required gate would be the very
defect this file exists to prevent.
WHY A DATE AND NOT A STATE. O-1..O-5 are WORK: they close when something is built, so an observable state is
the natural trigger. This is different. It is a deferred ENFORCEMENT, and the risk is not that we forget the
state arrived -- it is that the state never arrives and the check stays non-required forever. Every state
trigger here is self-deception, because the state is controlled by the same person who owes the enforcement:
`once the merge queue drains` is satisfied by never adding a task, which is never. A date cannot be postponed
by inaction; it can only be postponed by an edit, and an edit shows in a diff.
THE POPULATION IS DERIVED FROM THE FILESYSTEM, NOT FROM THIS FILE. The checker reads every job `name:` in
`.github/workflows/*.yml` and requires each one to appear in exactly one of: `contexts` in
config/required-checks.json (enforced), `deliberately_excluded` there (permanently excluded, with a reason),
or `deferrals` below (temporarily deferred, with a date). A new job wired into a workflow and named nowhere
is RED. That is what makes it impossible for a gate to quietly omit itself -- including this arrangement's
own gate.
STATUS AND SIGN-OFF follow tools/check_residual_items.py rather than inventing a second vocabulary: OPEN,
CLOSED and OWNER-DEFERRED, and a status other than OPEN is an audited verdict that needs a `sign_off`.
Extending a deferral costs the same signature: `deferred_until` more than 7 days after `first_declared`
requires a non-empty `sign_off`. Seven days, not thirty, because the work these deferrals wait on is
measured in nights.

Trust anchor · no production root privat.reason: The gate proves no literal in this tree is the private half of a pinned production root anchor, and it runs on every pull request. What it cannot do until this context is added to live branch protection is BLOCK a merge, and adding a context is a branch-protection change the Owner applies, not a Builder: check_repo_state compares config/required-checks.json against live GitHub, so a file claiming a protection that is not live would redden main instead of enforcing anything. Deferred seven days from its first green run on main, which is the same condition the promotion already pending for `Tools - gate self-tests on Windows (python)` waits on. Named as the third one-line edit in docs/OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED.md.
